@@ -44,28 +44,47 @@ check_mounted() {
   log "Loa mounted: v$(jq -r '.framework_version' "$VERSION_FILE")"
 }
 
+# cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.3): three outcomes per manifest path.
+#   present, hash matches            -> ok
+#   present, hash differs            -> Tampered (fail)
+#   absent, submodule mount detected (.loa/.claude is a directory) and the
+#     path exists under .loa/<path>   -> not-mounted (counted, one summary
+#     line, informational: never changes the exit code; the mount links a
+#     subset of the upstream tree by design)
+#   absent otherwise                 -> Missing (fail)
+# The manifest is read once (path<TAB>hash) instead of one jq call per path.
 check_integrity() {
   echo "Checking System Zone integrity (sha256)..."
   [[ -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]] || { warn "No checksums file - skipping integrity check"; return; }
 
   local drift=false
-  while IFS= read -r file; do
-    local expected=$(jq -r --arg f "$file" '.files[$f]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
-    [[ -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
+  local submodule_mount=false
+  local not_mounted=0
+  local file expected actual
+  [[ -d ".loa/.claude" ]] && submodule_mount=true
+
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r file expected; do
+    [[ -z "$file" || -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
 
     if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
-      local actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+      actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
       if [[ "$expected" != "$actual" ]]; then
         fail "Tampered: $file"
         drift=true
       fi
+    elif [[ "$submodule_mount" == "true" && -f ".loa/${file}" ]]; then
+      not_mounted=$((not_mounted + 1))
     else
       fail "Missing: $file"
       drift=true
     fi
-  done < <(jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
+  done < <(jq -r '.files | to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
 
+  if [[ $not_mounted -gt 0 ]]; then
+    log "not-mounted: ${not_mounted} path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"
+  fi
   [[ "$drift" == "false" ]] && log "Integrity verified"
+  return 0
 }

content.text: Diff is large, so I'll read the head files directly. Starting with the mount-integrity tooling and the sandbox mount library.

content.content:
1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/gen-checksums.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.1, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# Writes the System Zone integrity manifest `.claude/checksums.json` from the
     6	# TRACKED `.claude/` tree only. The legacy generators (mount-loa.sh and
     7	# update.sh `generate_checksums`) walk the working tree with `find`, so build,
     8	# cache and runtime artefacts (`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `node_modules`,
     9	# `.run/`) that exist only on the generating machine end up in the manifest and
    10	# read as Missing on every fresh mount. This generator lists
    11	#
    12	#   git -C ROOT ls-files -z -- .claude
    13	#
    14	# minus every path under `.claude/overrides/` (user-owned) and minus the
    15	# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with
    16	# `sha256_portable` (.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh) and writes
    17	#
    18	#   {"generated": "<UTC ISO-8601>", "algorithm": "sha256",
    19	#    "files": {"<path>": "<sha256 hex>", ...}}
    20	#
    21	# pretty-printed by jq (2-space), keys in `LC_ALL=C` byte order. Two runs on
    22	# the same tree are byte-identical except `generated`. The working-tree content
    23	# of each tracked path is hashed (an unstaged edit is reflected); a tracked
    24	# path deleted from the working tree is skipped with a warning on stderr.
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh [--root DIR] [--out FILE]   # (re)generate
    28	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh --check [--root DIR] [--out FILE]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --root DIR   repository work tree to read (default: the git top level of
    32	#                the current directory)
    33	#   --out FILE   manifest path (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json). With
    34	#                --check this is the committed manifest that is compared.
    35	#   --check      regenerate to a temp file and compare its `files` map with
    36	#                the manifest at --out; nothing is written
    37	#   -h, --help   this text
    38	#
    39	# Exit codes:
    40	#   0  generated, or --check: the `files` maps are identical
    41	#   1  --check: drift (the first ten differing paths, each labelled added /
    42	#      removed / changed, on stderr) or the manifest is absent / not JSON
    43	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or a tracked path name that
    44	#      cannot be represented safely (newline, tab or backslash)
    45	# =============================================================================
    46	set -euo pipefail

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/check-manifest-paths.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.2, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in
     6	# `.claude/checksums.json` must be TRACKED (`git ls-files -- .claude`) and
     7	# PRESENT in the working tree. A manifest generated by walking a dirty tree
     8	# (the #1267 class) lists build, cache and runtime artefacts that no fresh
     9	# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.
    10	#
    11	# Offenders are grouped on stderr:
    12	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
    13	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
    14	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
    15	#                      (a path component of that name)
    16	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
    17	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
    18	#                  other
    19	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
    20	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
    21	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
    22	#
    23	# Last line on stdout:
    24	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
    28	#
    29	# Options:
    30	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
    31	#                    current directory)
    32	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
    33	#   -h, --help       this text
    34	#
    35	# Exit codes:
    36	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
    37	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
    38	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
    39	#      not JSON with a `files` object
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	
    47	ROOT=""
    48	MANIFEST=""
    49	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    50	  case "$1" in
    51	    --root)
    52	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    53	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    54	    --manifest)
    55	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
    56	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    58	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    59	  esac
    60	done
    61	
    62	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    63	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    64	fi
    65	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    66	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    67	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    68	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    69	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
    70	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
    71	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    72	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
    73	
    74	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
    75	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    76	trap cleanup EXIT
    77	
    78	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
    79	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
    80	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
    81	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
    82	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
    83	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
    84	
    85	classify() {
    86	  local p="$1"
    87	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    88	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    89	  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    90	    printf '.pyc'
    91	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    92	    printf '.lock'
    93	  else
    94	    printf 'other'
    95	  fi
    96	}

    98	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
    99	: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   100	while IFS= read -r p; do
   101	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   102	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   103	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   104	
   105	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   106	while IFS= read -r p; do
   107	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   108	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   109	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   110	
   111	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   112	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   113	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   114	
   115	class_summary=""
   116	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
   117	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
   118	  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
   119	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   120	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   121	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   122	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   123	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   124	  done
   125	fi
   126	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   127	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   128	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   129	fi
   130	
   131	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"
   132	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 || "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   133	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   134	  exit 1
   135	fi
   136	exit 0

     4	#
     5	# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in
     6	# `.claude/checksums.json` must be TRACKED (`git ls-files -- .claude`) and
     7	# PRESENT in the working tree. A manifest generated by walking a dirty tree
     8	# (the #1267 class) lists build, cache and runtime artefacts that no fresh
     9	# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.
    10	#
    11	# Offenders are grouped on stderr:
    12	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
    13	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
    14	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
    15	#                      (a path component of that name)
    16	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
    17	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
    18	#                  other
    19	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
    20	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
    21	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
    22	#
    23	# Last line on stdout:
    24	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
    28	#
    29	# Options:
    30	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
    31	#                    current directory)
    32	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
    33	#   -h, --help       this text
    34	#
    35	# Exit codes:
    36	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
    37	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
    38	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
    39	#      not JSON with a `files` object
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	
    47	ROOT=""
    48	MANIFEST=""
    49	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    50	  case "$1" in
    51	    --root)
    52	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    53	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    54	    --manifest)
    55	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
    56	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    58	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    59	  esac
    60	done
    61	
    62	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    63	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    64	fi
    65	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    66	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    67	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    68	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    69	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
    70	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
    71	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    72	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
    73	
    74	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
    75	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    76	trap cleanup EXIT
    77	
    78	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
    79	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
    80	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
    81	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
    82	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
    83	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
    84	
    85	classify() {
    86	  local p="$1"
    87	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    88	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    89	  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    90	    printf '.pyc'
    91	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    92	    printf '.lock'
    93	  else
    94	    printf 'other'
    95	  fi
    96	}
    97	
    98	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
    99	: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   100	while IFS= read -r p; do
   101	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   102	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   103	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   104	
   105	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   106	while IFS= read -r p; do
   107	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   108	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   109	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   110	
   111	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   112	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   113	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   114	
   115	class_summary=""
   116	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
   117	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
   118	  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
   119	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   120	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   121	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   122	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   123	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   124	  done
   125	fi
   126	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   127	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   128	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   129	fi
   130	
   131	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"
   132	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 || "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   133	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   134	  exit 1
   135	fi
   136	exit 0

   375	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
   377	  local ws="$1"
   378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
   379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
   380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
   381	    return 0
   382	  fi
   383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
   384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
   386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
   387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
   388	  else
   389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
   390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
   391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
   392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
   393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
   394	    : > "$sums"
   395	    local -a batch=()
   396	    local f
   397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
   398	      batch+=("$f")
   399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
   400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
   401	        batch=()
   402	      fi
   403	    done < "$list"
   404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
   406	    fi
   407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
   408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
   410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
   411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
   412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
   413	  fi
   414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
   415	  local digest
   416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
   417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
   418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
   419	  return 0
   420	}

   423	check_fixture_path_rule() {
   424	  local dir="$1"

   426	  local p bad=""
   427	  for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run; do
   428	    if [[ -e "$dir/$p" || -L "$dir/$p" ]]; then bad="$bad $p"; fi
   429	  done
   430	  if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
   431	    echo "fixture path rule: $dir holds paths the Loa mount owns:$bad" >&2
   432	    return 2
   433	  fi
   434	  return 0

   438	write_sandbox_grimoire() {
   439	  local ws="$1" task="$2" arm="$3" label="${4:-sprint-1}"
   440	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
   441	  [[ -f "$task" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task yaml not found: $task"; return 2; }
   442	  [[ "$label" =~ ^sprint-[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: invalid sprint label '$label'"; return 2; }
   443	  local tid ttype criterion task_md
   444	  tid="$(yq -r '.id // ""' "$task")"; ttype="$(yq -r '.type // ""' "$task")"
   445	  criterion="$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$task")"
   446	  [[ "$tid" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task id '$tid' invalid"; return 2; }
   447	  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
   448	  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
   449	  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }
   450	
   451	  local sprint_plan=true
   452	  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
   453	    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
   454	    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
   455	      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
   456	    fi
   457	  fi
   458	
   459	  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
   460	  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
   461	  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
   462	  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
   463	    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
   464	     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
   465	     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
   466	               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
   467	               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
   468	     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
   469	    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
   470	  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
   471	  {
   472	    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
   473	    cat "$task_md"
   474	  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
   475	  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"
   476	
   477	  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
   478	    {
   479	      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
   480	      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'
   481	      printf '### Tasks\n\n- [x] Task 1.1: the change in `pr/head.diff`\n\n'
   482	      printf '### Review scope\n\nThe gates review `pr/head.diff` (pass `--diff-file pr/head.diff` to the adversarial review). Cite findings as `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from the `pr/head/` files.\n\n'
   483	      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
   484	    } > "$g/sprint.md"
   485	    local prmd="$ws/pr/PR.md" rcfx
   486	    if [[ ! -f "$prmd" ]]; then
   487	      rcfx="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$task")"
   488	      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
   489	      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"
   490	    fi
   491	    [[ -f "$prmd" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no PR.md for review-catch task $tid"; return 2; }
   492	    { printf '# Implementation Report: %s\n\n' "$label"; cat "$prmd"; } > "$g/a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
   493	    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.

91	_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
92	_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

94	_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
95	
96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
100	# hashes the corpus the same way.
101	_sm_sha256() {
102	  python3 -I -c '
103	import hashlib, sys
104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
107	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
108	            h.update(b)
109	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
110	}

112	# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
113	_sm_evidence() {
114	  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
115	  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
116	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
117	  else
118	    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
119	    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
120	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
121	  fi
122	}

96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh

101	_sm_sha256() {
102	  python3 -I -c '
103	import hashlib, sys
104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:

202	# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
203	# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
204	# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
205	_sm_drop_paragraph() {
206	  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
207	import re, sys
208	path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
209	text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
210	paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
211	for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
212	    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
213	        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
214	            removed = paras[i]
215	            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
216	            del paras[i:i + 2]

224	# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
225	# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
226	_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
227	  local f="$1" tmp
228	  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"

231	    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
232	    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
233	    { print }
234	    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
235	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
236	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
237	}

224	# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
225	# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
226	_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
227	  local f="$1" tmp
228	  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
229	  awk '
230	    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
231	    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
232	    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
233	    { print }
234	    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
235	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
236	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
237	}

239	# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
240	_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
241	  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
242	}

244	_sm_cfg_set_false() {  # _sm_cfg_set_false <cfg> <yq-path>... ; verifies each
245	  local cfg="$1"; shift
246	  [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
247	  local p
248	  for p in "$@"; do
249	    P="$p" yq -i 'eval(strenv(P)) = false' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || return 1
250	    [[ "$(P="$p" yq -r 'eval(strenv(P))' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == "false" ]] || return 1
251	  done
252	  return 0
253	}

255	apply_arm_toggles() {
256	  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
257	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
258	  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
259	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
260	  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
261	  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
262	  local key val
263	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
264	    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
265	    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
266	      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
267	    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
268	      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
269	    fi
270	    case "$key" in
271	      companion_voice)
272	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
273	          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
274	        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
275	        ;;
276	      karpathy_block)
277	        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
278	        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
279	        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
280	        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
281	          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
282	        fi
283	        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
284	        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
285	          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
286	          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
287	            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
288	          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
289	          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
290	          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
291	        fi
292	        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
293	        ;;
294	      rule_files)
295	        local r gone=""
296	        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
297	          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
298	          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
299	        done
300	        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
301	        ;;
302	      audit_delta_instruction)
303	        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
304	        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
305	        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
306	          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
307	        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
308	        ;;
309	      loa_mount)
310	        local p left=""
311	        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
312	          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
313	        done
314	        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
315	        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
316	        ;;
317	      effort)
318	        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
319	        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
320	          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
321	          total=$((total + 1))
322	          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
323	          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
324	        done
325	        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
326	        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
327	        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
328	          local nkeys
329	          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
330	          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
331	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
332	          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
333	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
334	          local wrong
335	          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
336	          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
337	          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
338	          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
339	            local h
340	            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
341	            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
342	            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
343	            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
344	          fi
345	        fi
346	        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
347	        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
348	        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
349	        ;;
350	      gates)
351	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
352	          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
353	        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
354	        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
355	        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
356	        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
357	        ;;
358	      flatline)
359	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
360	          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
361	        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
362	        ;;
363	      sprint_plan)
364	        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
365	        ;;
366	      context_resets)
367	        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
368	        ;;
369	      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
370	    esac

59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
88	#
89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
95	#
96	# Exit codes:
97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
98	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
99	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker

103	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
106	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
107	#
108	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,

753	  # --- record ---
754	  local result init_sid sid ledger_rows ledger_micro rf timed_out=false elapsed_ms

757	  if [[ -z "$result" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result"; then

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
4	#
5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
10	#
11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
14	#
15	# Derived fields:
16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
36	#
37	# Usage:
38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
41	#
42	# Options:
43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
54	#                      bad row naming its line number
55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
56	#
57	# Exit codes:
58	#   0  row written / file valid
59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
61	#
62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
64	# =============================================================================
65	set -euo pipefail
66	export LC_ALL=C
67	
68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
72	  case "$1" in
73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
85	  esac
86	done
87	
88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
89	
90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
93	  n=0 bad=0
94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
95	    n=$((n + 1))
96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"

12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).

15	# Derived fields:
16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads

28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
5	#
6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
11	#
12	# Rules:
13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
33	#                              are not frontmatter)
34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
37	#                              "no mount"
38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
42	#
43	# Usage:
44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
46	#
47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
50	#
51	# Exit codes:
52	#   0  every rule OK
53	#   1  any rule FAIL
54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
55	#
56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
58	# =============================================================================
59	set -euo pipefail
60	export LC_ALL=C
61	
62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
64	
65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
68	  case "$1" in
69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
76	  esac
77	done
78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
82	
83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
84	EVID=""
85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
90	}
91	
92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
93	  local type kind
94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
    65	
    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
    68	  local v
    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
    70	  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    71	  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
    72	  return 0
    73	}
    74	if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
    75	  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
    76	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
    77	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
    78	fi
    79	if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
    80	  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
    81	  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
    82	fi
    83	num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
    85

     2	# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
     3	# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
     4	# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
     5	# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
     6	# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
     7	# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
     8	# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
     9	#
    10	# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
    11	#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
    12	# Run:
    13	#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
    14	#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
    15	#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
    16	#
    17	# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
    18	#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
    19	FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
    20	RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br
    21	
    22	FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base
    23	
    24	ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
    25	ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
    26	ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
    27	ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0
    28	
    29	RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    30	    bash \
    31	    git \
    32	    jq \
    33	    python3 \
    34	    python3-pip \
    35	    python3-venv \
    36	    grep \
    37	    diffutils \
    38	    coreutils \
    39	    procps \
    40	    ca-certificates \
    41	    curl \
    42	    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
    43	
    44	# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
    45	ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
    46	ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
    47	ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
    48	RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
    49	    case "$arch" in \
    50	      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
    51	      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
    52	      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
    53	    esac && \
    54	    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
    55	      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
    56	    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
    57	    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
    58	
    59	# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
    60	RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
    61	      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
    62	      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
    63	    && npm cache clean --force
    64	
    65	# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
    66	RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
    67	# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
    68	# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
    69	RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"
    70	
    71	# bats-core at the pinned tag
    72	RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
    73	    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
    74	    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core
    75	
    76	# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
    77	RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true
    78	
    79	# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
    80	# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
    81	RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
    82	# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
    83	# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
    84	# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
    85	RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
    86	    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace
    87	
    88	ENV TZ=UTC
    89	ENV LC_ALL=C
    90	ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
    91	ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
    92	ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1
    93	
    94	USER evaluser
    95	WORKDIR /workspace
    96	
    97	# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
    98	RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
    99	    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
   100	    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
   101	    echo "All tools verified"
   102	
   103	ENTRYPOINT []
   104	CMD ["/bin/bash"]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
4	#
5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
6	#
7	# Usage:
8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
9	#
10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
16	#
17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# freeze.sh — cycle-130 ablation suite freeze (SDD §5.13, DEC-0404, DEC-0414)
     4	#
     5	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
     9	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
    10	#
    11	# Usage:
    12	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
    13	#
    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#
    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
    27	# =============================================================================
    28	set -euo pipefail
    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
    81	            h.update(b)
    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
    83	PY
    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}
    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
    87	
    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
    89	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
    90	compute_manifest "$TMP"
    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
    92	
    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }

     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/check-loa-mount-scope.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 #1267,
     5	# AC-1.2/AC-1.3; SDD §5.3). check-loa.sh check_integrity classifies every
     6	# manifest path as ok, Tampered (fail), not-mounted (a submodule mount does
     7	# not link it but .loa/<path> has it: counted, one summary line, never a
     8	# failure) or Missing (fail).
     9	#
    10	# Seam: check-loa.sh already guards `main` behind
    11	#   [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]
    12	# so each case sources the script in a child bash inside the fixture
    13	# directory and calls check_integrity alone; the child exits 1 when the
    14	# FAILURES counter is non-zero, the same rule main applies. No other check
    15	# runs, and the script is not modified for the test.
    16	# =============================================================================
    17	
    18	setup() {
    19	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    20	  CHECK="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh"
    21	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cloams.XXXXXX")"
    22	  D="$T/downstream"
    23	  # upstream tree inside the submodule path
    24	  mkdir -p "$D/.loa/.claude/lib" "$D/.claude"
    25	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh"
    26	  printf 'echo b\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh"
    27	  printf 'echo c\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh"
    28	  # the mount links a.sh only (b.sh and lib/c.sh are not linked)
    29	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/a.sh "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    30	  printf 'aleph:\n  enabled: false\n' > "$D/.loa.config.yaml"
    31	  source "$ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    32	  HA="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    33	  HB="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    34	  HC="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    35	  write_manifest
    36	}
    37	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    38	
    39	# write_manifest [extra-path hash]... — a/b/lib/c plus any extra pairs
    40	write_manifest() {
    41	  local args=(--arg a "$HA" --arg b "$HB" --arg c "$HC")
    42	  local filter='{".claude/a.sh": $a, ".claude/b.sh": $b, ".claude/lib/c.sh": $c}'
    43	  if [[ $# -ge 2 ]]; then
    44	    args+=(--arg xp "$1" --arg xh "$2")
    45	    filter="$filter + {(\$xp): \$xh}"
    46	  fi
    47	  jq -n "${args[@]}" "{generated: \"2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\", algorithm: \"sha256\", files: ($filter)}" \
    48	    > "$D/.claude/checksums.json"
    49	}
    50	
    51	run_integrity() {
    52	  run bash -c 'cd "$1" && source "$2" && check_integrity && echo "FAILURES=$FAILURES" && [[ $FAILURES -eq 0 ]]' \
    53	    _ "$D" "$CHECK"
    54	}
    55	
    56	@test "CM-1 paths in the upstream tree but not linked are not-mounted; exit unaffected" {
    57	  run_integrity
    58	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    59	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"* ]]
    60	  [[ "$output" == *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    61	  [[ "$output" != *"Missing:"* ]]
    62	  [[ "$output" != *"Tampered:"* ]]
    63	  [ "$(grep -c 'not-mounted:' <<< "$output")" -eq 1 ]
    64	}
    65	
    66	@test "CM-2 a present file whose hash differs is Tampered and fails" {
    67	  rm -f "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    68	  printf 'echo tampered\n' > "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    69	  run_integrity
    70	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    71	  [[ "$output" == *"Tampered: .claude/a.sh"* ]]
    72	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    73	  [[ "$output" == *"FAILURES=1"* ]]
    74	}
    75	
    76	@test "CM-3 a path absent locally and upstream is Missing and fails" {
    77	  write_manifest .claude/gone.sh "$HA"
    78	  run_integrity
    79	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    80	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/gone.sh"* ]]
    81	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s)"* ]]
    82	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    83	}
    84	
    85	@test "CM-4 without a .loa/ submodule an absent path is Missing" {
    86	  find "$D/.loa" -mindepth 1 -delete
    87	  rmdir "$D/.loa"
    88	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.claude/a.sh.real"
    89	  rm -f "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    90	  mv "$D/.claude/a.sh.real" "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    91	  run_integrity
    92	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    93	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/b.sh"* ]]
    94	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/lib/c.sh"* ]]
    95	  [[ "$output" != *"not-mounted"* ]]
    96	}
    97	
    98	@test "CM-5 every path linked and matching: Integrity verified, no not-mounted line" {
    99	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/b.sh "$D/.claude/b.sh"
   100	  mkdir -p "$D/.claude/lib"
   101	  ln -s ../../.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh "$D/.claude/lib/c.sh"
   102	  run_integrity
   103	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]

   106	}

   113	}

18:+  bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; source "$1"; shift; "$@"' _ "$REPO_ROOT/$LIB_REL" "$@"

21:+# The prompt tree as the pipeline mounts it: a catalog with two default_effort
22:+# entries and its .checksum, a second skill with an effort line, the beads
23:+# state script, and an overrides/ file the manifest must skip.
24:+extend_tree() {
25:+  mkdir -p "$PT/.claude/defaults" "$PT/.claude/skills/implementing-tasks" "$PT/.claude/scripts/beads" "$PT/.claude/overrides"
26:+  printf '%s\n' "providers:" "  anthropic:" "    models:" "      claude-opus-5-5:" "        params:" "          default_effort: high" \
27:+    "      claude-fable-5-1:" "        params:" "          default_effort: xhigh" > "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml"
28:+  sha256sum_of "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" > "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml.checksum"
29:+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: implementing-tasks" "effort: xhigh" "model: opus" "---" "# Implement" "effort: this body line stays" \
30:+    > "$PT/.claude/skills/implementing-tasks/SKILL.md"
31:+  cp "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh" "$PT/.claude/scripts/beads/"

37:+integrity_in() {

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# regen.sh — rebuild the fixture run directories under runs/ (cycle-130 Sprint 258)
     3	#
     4	# Each fixture is a real evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh run (host executor) against
     5	# the stub CLI (../claude-stub-pipeline.sh) and the stub mount library
     6	# (../mount-lib-stub.sh), using suite.yaml and the tasks under tasks/. The sandbox's
     7	# own .git and the snapshot bundles are dropped (no nested repositories in the
     8	# tracked tree); absolute paths are rewritten to /fixture and /home/operator.
     9	# grade.json files and MANIFEST.json are written here as Sprint 259's grader and
    10	# run-ablation.sh would shape them (SDD §3.4, §3.6).
    11	#
    12	# Usage: evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/regen.sh
    13	# Consumers: evals/tests/ablation-row.bats, evals/tests/took-effect.bats
    14	set -euo pipefail
    15	export LC_ALL=C
    16	
    17	HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    18	FIX="$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)"

    20	GEN="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/abl-fixture.XXXXXX")"

    55	find "$OUT" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    56	mkdir -p "$OUT"

    59	  local name="$1" arm="$2" task="$3" rc=0; shift 3
    60	  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$GEN/stub.env"

    62	    --run-id "abl-fixture-$arm-$task-t1" --trial 1 --source-tree "$GEN/src" --suite-file "$HERE/suite.yaml" \
    63	    --executor host --claude-bin "$GEN/claude" > "$GEN/last.log" 2>&1 || { rc=$?; sed -n "1,20p" "$GEN/last.log" >&2; }
    64	  echo "regen: $name ($arm on $task) exit $rc"

   104	JSON

   107	        agy_opt_in: false,

   112	                  "abl-fixture-a1_full-rc-01-t1": "a1_full", "abl-fixture-a4_no_gates-rc-01-t1": "a4_no_gates"}}' > "$HERE/MANIFEST.json"

    87	  [ "$(jq -r '.reserve_usd' <<<"$output")" = "250" ]

    10	
    11	setup() {
    12	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    13	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    14	  FZ="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/freeze.sh"
    15	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fz.XXXXXX")"
    16	  R="$T/suite"; mkdir -p "$R"
    17	  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
    18	  # shellcheck source=fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
    19	  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
    20	  # shellcheck source=../../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
    21	  source "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    22	  make_task "$R" tasks bug-fix-01 bug-fix

    27	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    28	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
    29	}
    30	
    31	@test "FZ-1 freeze writes one sorted '<sha256>  <relpath>' line per file under tasks/; --check then passes" {
    32	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial
    33	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    34	  grep -q '^freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (' <<<"$output"
    35	  M="$R/MANIFEST.sha256"
    36	  [ "$(grep -c . "$M")" -eq "$(cd "$R" && find tasks -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" ]
    37	  [ "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M")" = "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M" | LC_ALL=C sort)" ]
    38	  ! grep -qv '^[0-9a-f]\{64\}  tasks/' "$M"
    39	  want="$(cd "$R" && sha256_portable tasks/bug-fix-01/task.yaml)"
    40	  grep -qxF "$want" "$M"
    41	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check
    42	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    43	  grep -q '^freeze: OK — ' <<<"$output"
    44	}

    47	  "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial >/dev/null
